gloss: high school graduate; high school diploma

definitions.gloss: high school graduate; high school diploma
definitions.explanation: A person who has graduated from high school, or the educational background of having completed high school. An abbreviation of {高校|こうこう}{卒業|そつぎょう}.

examples.english: He is a high school graduate.

examples.japanese: {高卒|こうそつ}で{就職|しゅうしょく}する{人|ひと}も{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Many people get jobs right after graduating high school.

examples.japanese: この{求人|きゅうじん}は{高卒|こうそつ}{以上|いじょう}が{応募|おうぼ}{条件|じょうけん}になっている。
examples.english: The requirement for this job posting is at least a high school diploma.

notes:
Abbreviation of {高校|こうこう}{卒業|そつぎょう} (high school graduation). Commonly used in job listings and on resumes to indicate educational background.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高卒|こうそつ}{以上|いじょう} — high school diploma or above (job requirement)
- {高卒|こうそつ}で{働|はたら}く — to start working after high school
- {高卒|こうそつ}{資格|しかく} — high school equivalency

RELATED WORDS:
- {大卒|だいそつ} — university graduate
- {中卒|ちゅうそつ} — junior high school graduate
- {院卒|いんそつ} — graduate school graduate
- {学歴|がくれき} — educational background
